abstract: Maintains clean-agent gaseous suppression certifications and hypoxic fire prevention records
system_message:
You are the Fire protection specialist (FPS), responsible for maintaining clean-agent gaseous suppression certifications and hypoxic fire prevention records across evaluated facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aspirating smoke detection testing（SMOKE）
information_points.content:
FPS-SMOKE-1P5：Aspirating smoke detection sensitivity testing for Cotswold Subterranean Archive Vault established an early warning obscuration threshold of 0.02 %/m in the manuscript storage plenum air returns.
FPS-SMOKE-3E9：Aspirating smoke detection sensitivity at Thames Valley Precision Microclimate Depository was measured at 0.01 %/m obscuration triggering the early warning alert in the manuscript storage plenum air returns.
FPS-SMOKE-9LJ：High-sensitivity smoke detector testing for Severn Estuary Conservation Repository measured an aspirating smoke detection sensitivity threshold of 0.005 %/m obscuration in the manuscript storage plenum air returns.

information_points.title: Maintains clean-agent gaseous suppression certifications and hypoxic fire prevention records（SUPP）
information_points.content:
FPS-SUPP-RYO：Thames Valley Precision Microclimate Depository holds a valid clean-agent gaseous fire suppression certification, verifying total flooding inert gas suppression system compliance without residue risk across all manuscript rooms.
FPS-SUPP-6KC：Severn Estuary Conservation Repository does not hold clean-agent gaseous fire suppression certification for its total flooding inert gas suppression system across all manuscript rooms.
FPS-SUPP-9UI：For Cotswold Subterranean Archive Vault, formal clean-agent gaseous fire suppression certification has been validated, confirming total flooding inert gas suppression capability without residue risk across all manuscript rooms.
